description: This file defines the EntityIdExists class, which represents a validation rule to check if an entity with a given ID exists in the database. It is part of a plugin's API version 2 validator rules for entity ID validation within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EntityIdExists
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies whether an entity with a specified ID exists in the database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EntityIdExists rule with the specified entity name and optional configuration options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to check if the provided input is a valid existing entity ID based on the rule's options.
